note: The post-procedure evaluator's thresholds (2026-09-30, docs/evaluateur.fr.md, E1): its detectors are queries on the harness's graph (lib/evaluator.ts), deterministic, with no model; what each counts as recurring, divergent or changed is said here, not in the code. Never adaptable by the reflection (specs/harness/**).

recurrence.note: a form is recurring from this many tasks, the memory's own threshold (specs/harness/memory.json)

firstRetry.note: D2: the share of a correction's tasks where the accepted attempt was the first retry

divergence.note: D3: two models on the same cases (the same request, its measurements and times out), under the same reading (fingerprint and memory), each with at least minTasks tasks on them: a form is frequent under one from this rate, rare under the other up to this one

change.note: D5: one model, the same memory, two fingerprints in a row, each with at least minTasks tasks: a form whose rate of tasks changed by minChange or more, in at least minWithForm tasks on the side it is frequent

commits.note: D5, for fingerprints before E0 (no text of the tools kept): the files changed between the two commits, from git; the texts a model is given and the settings a model is run with (its output limit, its effort) are named, the rest counted as code, those of no run left out

models.note: the tasks the evaluator does not read, by their model: a script is a stand-in whose mistakes are written on purpose (a test's), not a model's

stuck.note: D4: how the harness ends a task stuck in a loop (harness/core/runner.ts)
